description: Create the complete index.html file for MDWA product reference page. This is a single, self-contained HTML file that follows the visual design and UX of index (10).html but with all MDWA content. Includes sticky header with WhatsApp, floating WA button, 10-tab interface, full product content for all plans, premium tables, working calculator with embedded data, password-protected komisi section, training materials, and FAQ.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/Project-mdwa/index.html as a complete self-contained HTML file
Include all CSS inline (same style patterns as index (10).html - green gradient theme, card layout, responsive design)
Sticky WA banner at top: 'Petrus Jakub Partner Bisnis Manulife' + WA logo + 087781896087, links to https://wa.me/6287781896087?text=Pak%20Petrus%2C%20saya%20mau%20tanya%20soal%20MDWA
Floating WA button bottom-right with same link
Header: 'MDWA - Manulife Dynamic Wealth Assurance' with subtitle 'Produk Tabungan Terstruktur | Kekayaan Pasti untuk Masa Depan'

Tab 0 (Ringkasan): Overview of MDWA as wealth accumulation product (NOT death benefit product). Explain 3 plans: Plan A (Anuitas/Annuity), Plan B (Beasiswa/Education), Plan C (Combo/Endowment). Use simple language for laypeople.

Tab 1 (Plan Anuitas): Detailed Plan A explanation - stable annual cash flow for retirement. Cover: Masa Pertanggungan 20/30 thn, MPP Sekaligus/5/10 thn, annual payouts starting year 6/10/15, Banding 1 & 2 differences, IDR and USD rates.
Tab 2 (Plan Beasiswa): Detailed Plan B explanation - education fund. Cover: Masa Pertanggungan 5-30 thn, MPP options, lump sum at end of term.
Tab 3 (Plan Combo): Detailed Plan C explanation - annual payouts + maturity benefit. Cover: Masa Pertanggungan 10/15/20/30 thn, MPP options, both annual and end benefit.
Tab 4 (Perbandingan): Comparison table of all 3 plans with clear differences in structure, benefits, target audience, payment schedule.
Tab 5 (Tabel Premi): Display premium data tables for IDR Plan A. Show the key combinations: Manfaat 50/100/150/200/250 Juta, Term 20/30, MPP Sekaligus/5/10, with Premi and Total Manfaat columns.

Tab 6 (Kalkulator - MOST IMPORTANT): Working calculator with all premium data embedded in JavaScript. User selects: Plan (A/B/C), Mata Uang (IDR/USD), Manfaat Tunai Tahunan amount, Masa Pertanggungan, Masa Pembayaran Premi. Shows: base premium, total manfaat, payment schedule breakdown, mode options (Tahunan/Semesteran/Kuartalan/Bulanan with factors 1x/0.525x/0.275x/0.095x). Handles invalid combinations with 'Tidak Tersedia' message. Embed all IDR premium data from the task description.
Tab 7 (Komisi): Password-protected section (password: 'manulife'). Show commission structure for all 3 plans with Single/5Pay/10Pay breakdowns per the task description data.

Tab 8 (Materi Training): Training materials including: target segments, product positioning (wealth vs insurance), sales ideas, key selling points, GIO underwriting advantage, rider options (ALP Plus, WOP Plus, Payor Benefit Plus).

Tab 9 (FAQ): At least 10 questions covering: What is MDWA, difference between plans, is it unit-link, minimum premium, entry age, how payouts work, what happens if die during term (ADB/TPD), Banding 1 vs 2, grace period, free look period.
All JavaScript must be vanilla (no external libraries). Calculator must work offline. All data embedded inline.
Responsive design with media queries for mobile (same breakpoints as reference: 768px and 480px).
acceptance_criteria: File is a valid self-contained HTML document with no external dependencies
All 10 tabs are navigable and display correct MDWA content
Sticky WA header shows correct name, number, and links to WhatsApp with correct pre-filled message about MDWA
Floating WA button links to same WhatsApp URL
Calculator correctly computes premiums for Plan A IDR combinations using embedded data
Calculator shows 'Tidak Tersedia' for invalid combinations
Komisi section is password-protected with password 'manulife'
All content is in Bahasa Indonesia with simple language for laypeople
Design follows the green Manulife theme from the reference file
